Beverly International's Collagen Peptides powder for men and women can help revitalize skin, strengthen hair, renew nails naturally.
Distinguishing features:
Just one ingredient.
20 Grams of Types I and III Collagen Peptides per serving from grass-fed bovine sources.
Hydrolyzed Bovine Collagen: Our clean and pure hydrolyzed collagen peptides are tasteless and highly absorbable.
Diverse Amino Acid Profile: Rich in protein and amino acids. Beverly's Collagen Peptides naturally contains 18 vital amino acids and is packed with 18 grams of protein per serving.
Easy to use: Stir it into anything you'd like, and it blends right in. It dissolves in cold or hot liquids - coffee, tea, smoothies, or even water. One serving a day is all you need.

Key Collagen Peptides Benefits:
Youthful appearance: Skin hydration, skin elasticity
Strong hair and nails
Joint function
Muscle recovery

20 Grams of Types I and III Hydrolyzed Collagen Peptides Per Serving

Mix 2 scoops in 8 oz of your preferred liquid.
